parts.text: Start a graph-based pediatric dentistry oral-board case focused on trauma management.

property.description: The case builder follows the required sequence: set_loading_step, search_docs, read_doc, set_case, and set_phase.
The workflow uses request_input with a readiness prompt and does not enter clinical questioning until the candidate responds.
The case content is grounded in retrieved source chips and includes the real-exam note that examiners withhold feedback and report Pass/Fail.
The workflow does not score or provide model answers during the case-building phase.
